From acclaimed director Francis Lawrence, THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING follows sixteen-year-old Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) from District 12, beginning on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Annual Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell, the biggest Games yet with twice as many tributes.

Set in the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, the story follows Haymitch into the arena, where he forms an unlikely alliance with fellow tribute Maysilee Donner (Mckenna Grace) and joins a coalition determined to challenge the Capitol’s control under President Snow (Ralph Fiennes). As the competition unfolds, Haymitch risks everything to take down the Games from within the arena — setting in motion the rebellion that will change Panem forever.

snippet.title: River | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
RIVER "will drown you in pure terror." (TheWrap) Only in theaters January 15

The sun is down. The boat is dead. There’s no cell service. And there’s someone standing, staring, from the shore. From the producers of Backrooms and Obsession comes a vivid, visceral new vision in the slasher genre, marking an electrifying feature-film debut by writer-director Joshua Giuliano. 

River stars Jane Levy (Don’t Breathe, Evil Dead), Jessica Rothe (Happy Death Day films, Pulse) and Max Mattern (Cape Fear, Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy) as estranged siblings who reunite in their rural hometown after the death of their father. As they set out to scatter his ashes at his favorite spot on a remote river, the trip devolves into a fight for survival as they are mercilessly hunted by a disturbing masked figure played by Dane DiLiegro (Prey, Only Murders in the Building).

Acquired by Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster following a rapturous screening at Midnight Madness at the Toronto International Film Festival, River is produced by Steven Schneider (executive producer Insidious franchise, Split) via his company Spooky Pictures, and Nick Antosca (creator Cape Fear series, Verity) and Alex Hedlund (executive producer Cape Fear series, Verity) via their company Eat The Cat. 

The film’s executive producers are Jeffrey Tinnell, Robert Tinnell, Matt Brodlie, Jonathan Kier, Ben Ross and Jason Blum. Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Independent Film Company present a Shudder Original Production, in association with Upgrade.

Cansados del desabasto crítico de medicamentos que condena a los pacientes, de jornadas explotadoras y de trabajar sin insumos básicos, médicos y enfermeros tomaron las calles de la CDMX y varios estados exigiendo condiciones dignas bajo la amenaza de un paro nacional.

 La respuesta institucional no fue el diálogo ni el abastecimiento de farmacias, sino una salvaje represión con la fuerza pública. Mientras a otros grupos se les otorgan privilegios y tolerancia, al gremio médico se le ataca con garrotes y desprecio, dejando al descubierto la ruina del sistema de salud y la cobarde censura a la protesta social.

snippet.title: Une jeunesse INCULTE, DÉBILE, SAUVAGE
snippet.description:
Sous-estimer et vomir la jeunesse… sûrement l’une des plus importantes (et navrante) constante historique.

Propos tenue ce dimanche 11 octobre aux Rendez-vous de l’histoire de Blois. La conférence portait sur les « Mythes de l’histoire de France », et sur les fonctions qu’ils remplissent (analyse au cœur de « France fictions » mais aussi des livres présentés là par Charles-Éloi Vial, Vincent Hugeux et Johann Elbory).

Et comme Hésiode qui se plaignait d’une jeunesse insupportable et sans retenue en la comparant à un passé fantasmé, comme Socrate reprochant aux jeunes d’êtres rustres et mal élevés, comme Aristote à sa suite… l’histoire est « convoquée » aujourd’hui pour condamner toute une génération.

Acte de paresse et de panique, qui ne permet rien. Cocasse, de la part de ceux qui appellent au « dialogue ».

snippet.title: How the War in Ukraine Began and Where It Stands Today 🗺️ Russia–Ukraine War
snippet.description:
How the War in Ukraine Began and Where It Stands Today 🗺️ Russia–Ukraine War

In 1991, Ukraine became independent as the Soviet Union collapsed 🇺🇦 Three years later, it gave up the world's third-largest nuclear arsenal in exchange for promises that its borders would be respected, including by Russia. In 2014, after protests in Kyiv, Russia annexed Crimea and Russian-backed separatists took parts of Donetsk and Luhansk. On February 24, 2022, Russia launched a full-scale invasion from the north, east and south. Kyiv held, Russian forces pulled out of the north, but Mariupol fell after an 86-day siege. That autumn, Ukraine retook most of the Kharkiv region and liberated Kherson 📍 Then the war became a grinding fight of trenches and drones: Bakhmut, Avdiivka and Pokrovsk fell, and Ukraine's push into Russia's Kursk region was reversed. Today, Russia holds about 20% of Ukraine, nearly 6 million Ukrainians live abroad as refugees, and talks have yet to produce a full ceasefire. The map is still being drawn.

snippet.title: Russia violated Trump’s energy ceasefire, Zelensky says
snippet.description:
Russia continued striking Ukraine’s energy infrastructure after U.S. President Donald Trump announced an energy ceasefire, President Volodymyr Zelensky said at the Warsaw Security Forum on Oct. 12.

Trump claimed on his Truth Social platform that both Kyiv and Moscow agreed to an energy truce — an announcement that took Ukrainian officials by surprise.

The Ukrainian president confirmed that Kyiv learned of the supposed truce only from media reports, but reiterated his readiness to adhere to it — provided that Russia follows suit.

Zelensky said Russian jet-powered Shahed drones were already flying over Ukraine when Trump announced the ceasefire on Oct. 11.

A Russian drone struck a Ukrainian gas production facility around midnight, while several drones targeted a civilian gas station, he said.

“Last night, Russian oil refineries were not burning,” Zelensky said. “So, there were Russian violations of the energy ceasefire announced by President Trump.”

Video: Warsaw Security Forum

snippet.title: Camouflaged Data Centers
snippet.description:
Writer: Brett Stelmaszek
Editor: Rikus Strauss
Music by: @UFD-Music

It’s fine if they install data centers everywhere, you won’t even notice them with their camouflage.
Microsoft’s been found to be using a “biomimicry” program to deploy their massive compute farms in new places like nature gardens and wetlands.
The idea is that the buildings blend into the natural landscape so it’s less disturbing to the wildlife and natural order.
Unfortunately, none of that, including their addition of extra woodland and pollinator restoration, helps to offset the gas turbine generators they deploy in order to power the data centers.
